answer.statement: Carry out self inspections to monitor how GMP principles are implemented and complied with.
answer.change: Dropped the purpose of proposing necessary corrective measures.

answer.statement: Examine personnel matters, premises, equipment, documentation, production, quality control, distribution of medicinal products, complaint and recall arrangements, and self inspection itself at intervals, to verify they conform with Quality Assurance principles.
answer.change: Dropped the requirement that examinations follow a pre-arranged programme.

answer.statement: Have self inspections performed in detail by designated, competent company personnel.
answer.change: Dropped the requirement that self inspections be independent.

answer.statement: Optionally use audits by external experts in addition.
answer.change: Dropped the qualifier that the external audits be independent.

answer.statement: Keep a record of self inspections.
answer.change: Dropped the scope that every self inspection must be recorded.

answer.statement: Self inspection reports include every observation made.
answer.change: Dropped proposed corrective measures, where applicable, from the required report content.

answer.statement: Record statements on the actions taken afterwards.
answer.change: Dropped the scope tying the recorded actions to self inspections.

answer.statement: Design the self-inspection programme to find any gaps in GMP implementation.
answer.change: Dropped the requirement to recommend the necessary corrective actions.

answer.statement: Perform self-inspections.
answer.change: Dropped the frequency qualifier that self-inspections be routine.

answer.statement: Optionally perform additional self-inspections on special occasions, for example product recalls or an announced health authority inspection.
answer.change: Dropped repeated rejections from the listed special occasions.

answer.statement: Staff the self-inspection team with people able to assess GMP implementation.
answer.change: Dropped the requirement that the assessment be objective.

answer.statement: Implement corrective action recommendations.
answer.change: Dropped the scope that all recommendations must be implemented.
Impossible: the item states a single bare obligation with no condition, qualifier or detail to drop.

answer.statement: Maintain a follow-up programme for self-inspections.
answer.change: Dropped the qualifier that the follow-up programme be effective.

answer.statement: Establish written self-inspection instructions that set a uniform standard of requirements.
answer.change: Dropped the qualifier that the standard be a minimum standard.

answer.statement: Optionally include GMP questionnaires in the instructions, covering at least personnel; premises including personnel facilities; building and equipment maintenance; storage of starting materials and finished products; equipment; production and in-process controls; QC; documentation; sanitation and hygiene; validation and revalidation programmes; calibration of instruments or measurement systems; recall procedures; complaints management; and results of previous self-inspections with corrective steps taken.
answer.change: Dropped labels control from the list of minimum questionnaire items.

answer.statement: Management appoints a self-inspection team of subject experts.
answer.change: Dropped the requirement that team members be familiar with GMP.

answer.statement: Team members can be appointed from within the company.
answer.change: Dropped the option of appointing team members from outside the company.

answer.statement: Set self-inspection frequency according to company needs.
answer.change: Dropped the preferred minimum frequency of at least once a year.

answer.statement: State the self-inspection frequency.
answer.change: Dropped the requirement that the frequency be stated in the procedure.

answer.statement: Prepare a report for self-inspections.
answer.change: Dropped the requirement that a report be made at the completion of each self-inspection.

answer.statement: The self-inspection report covers the results and the recommended corrective actions.
answer.change: Dropped evaluation and conclusions from the required report content.

answer.statement: Maintain a follow-up programme for self-inspection outcomes.
answer.change: Dropped the qualifier that the follow-up programme be effective.

answer.statement: Company management reviews the self-inspection report.
answer.change: Dropped management evaluation of the corrective actions.
Impossible: the item is a bare optional statement with no condition, qualifier or detail to drop.

answer.statement: Optionally extend quality audits to suppliers.
answer.change: Dropped contractors from the scope of extended audits.

answer.statement: The person responsible for QC, with other relevant departments, is responsible for approving suppliers able to reliably provide starting and packaging materials.
answer.change: Dropped the requirement that supplied materials meet established specifications.

answer.statement: Evaluate suppliers and add them to the approved supplier list or specifications.
answer.change: Dropped the timing condition that evaluation occur before approval and listing.

answer.statement: Supplier evaluation considers the supplier's history.
answer.change: Dropped the nature of the materials to be supplied from the evaluation criteria.

answer.statement: Supplier audits determine whether the supplier can conform with GMP standards.
